milestone: Outcome learning — closing the loop from predicted opportunity to realized truth
opportunity: product_arbitrage, category 'collectibles', source 'ebay_us', predicted confidence 0.883, projected profit $117.57

outcome_recorded.opp_status_after: executed (moved out of execution into a recorded outcome)

measurable_effect_on_future_scoring.effect: surfaces as a per-opportunity 'Downranked — past losses in collectibles' signal in /api/opportunities (_row.personal), changing how future collectibles opportunities are selected
measurable_effect_on_future_scoring.weight_effect: the walk-away reason's score factor now weighs more in ALL future opportunity scoring (weights renormalised to sum 1.0)

honesty_boundaries_held_live.calibration_rationale: an honest walk-away is not a cash test of the prediction, so it moves neither calibration nor source reliability
honesty_boundaries_held_live.predictions_did_not_train_predictions: the learning signal carried basis=realized_cash with realized=0 and was driven by the recorded abandonment + reason, never by the $117.57 prediction

note: The success/failure calibration paths (realized cash -> calibration + source/verifier boosts) are covered by the 17 deterministic tests in tests/test_outcomes.py; the honest LIVE outcome here is an abandonment. Full suite: 379 passed, 1 skipped.
